findings.detail: The branch carries the prior omniroute-integration task's commits (FEAT-003/004/005 OmniRoute tier-dropdown work: webview-ui/src/components/chat/OmniRouteTierDropdown.tsx, src/api/providers/omniroute.ts, packages/types omniRouteTier schema) ahead of the three zoo-parallel-fabric commits. Out of scope for this review; the three workstreams are cleanly isolated in commits 49c9075bb/91344f811/397c98cc4 (git diff fa00ee99c..HEAD). No action needed beyond awareness that git diff main..HEAD is broader than these three features.

Threading tests cover condenseContext()->summarizeConversation and handleContextWindowExceededError()->manageContext (set+unset), but the third condensing site attemptApiRequest()->manageContext has no direct threading assertion. It is wired with the identical `await this.getCondensingApiHandler()` -> `apiHandler:` pattern and is covered by tsc + the shared resolver, so this is not blocking; a third threading case would complete the symmetry.
